name: Zoe Rayne
location: Tower of the Rayne Syndicate, Windswept Island
description: Zoe Rayne is the leader of the Rayne Syndicate. Her partner Pal is Grizzbolt, and she can be recruited as an ally after being defeated for the first time.

name: Lovander
location: Twilight Dunes and Desiccated Dunes at night
description: Lovander roams at night in pursuit of affection. Once interested only in other Pals, it has recently begun chasing humans too.

name: Lily Everhart
location: Free Pal Alliance Tower, Crescent Moon Shore
description: Lily Everhart is the leader of the Free Pal Alliance and fights alongside her partner Pal, Lyleen.

name: Katress
location: Crescent Moon Shore, Verdant Brook and Scars of War at night
description: Katress uses shadow power to create arcane phenomena, prefers raw food, and has a fierce rivalry with Wixen.

name: Saya Kurosaki
description: Saya Kurosaki is the leader of the Moonflower Clan. Her partner Pal is Selyne, and her Tower is located on Sakurajima Island.

name: Wixen
description: Wixen uses light to create arcane phenomena, likes its food well-done, and is especially hostile toward Katress.

name: Anubis
description: Anubis was once revered as a noble symbol by those who rejected wealth and power, but eventually became associated with death.

name: Lunaris
description: Lunaris can control anyone careless enough to meet its gaze; companions seen beside it may already be under its influence.
